mascot: Coach Gramma — a cheerful gym coach with a whistle who trains words to do their proper jobs in every sentence.

slides.title: Words Have Jobs! 🏋️
slides.text: In a sentence, every word has a job to do! Some name things, some show action, some describe. Let's meet the word team!
slides.spoken: Every word has a job: naming, acting or describing!

slides.title: Nouns: The Namers 🏷️
slides.text: Nouns are naming words: boy, city, dog, book. If you can point at it or name it — it is a noun!
slides.spoken: Nouns name things: boy, city, dog, book!

slides.title: Verbs: The Doers 🏃
slides.text: Verbs are action words: run, sing, eat, write. They show what the noun is doing!
slides.spoken: Verbs show the action: run, sing, eat, write!

slides.title: Adjectives: The Describers 🌈
slides.text: Adjectives describe nouns: a BRAVE dog, a RED ball, a TALL tree. They add colour to our sentences!
slides.spoken: Adjectives describe nouns: brave, red, tall!

slides.title: The Full Team! 🏆
slides.text: 'The brave dog barks loudly.' Noun: dog. Verb: barks. Adjective: brave. Every word did its job — champions!
slides.spoken: Noun, verb, adjective — together they build strong sentences!

challenges.question: Which word is a noun (a naming word)?
challenges.hint: Which one names a thing you can carry things in?
challenges.misconception: Basket is a noun — it names a thing! Quickly shows how and green describes colour.

challenges.question: Which word is a verb?
challenges.hint: Which one is something you can DO?
challenges.misconception: Sing is a verb — it shows action! Sweet describes taste and sky names a thing.

challenges.question: Which word is an adjective (a describing word)?
challenges.hint: Which word describes how something looks?
challenges.misconception: Bright is an adjective — it describes how something looks! Run shows action and lamp names a thing.

challenges.question: Fill the blank with an adjective: 'The ___ dog barks loudly.'
challenges.hint: We need a describing word for the dog. Which one describes?
challenges.misconception: Brave is the adjective: 'The brave dog barks loudly.' Bark is an action and bravely describes an action.

challenges.question: In 'The cat sat on the mat', the word 'mat' is ___
challenges.hint: A mat is a thing you can point at!
challenges.misconception: Mat names a thing, so it is a noun — just like cat!

challenges.question: Drag each word into its job: noun, verb or adjective?
challenges.hint: River and teacher name. Swim shows action. Blue describes!
challenges.misconception: River and Teacher are nouns. Swim is a verb. Blue is an adjective!

challenges.question: Which adjective describes ice?
challenges.hint: Touch an ice cube — how does it feel?
challenges.misconception: Ice is cold! Cold is the adjective that describes ice.

challenges.question: In 'My grandmother tells funny stories', which word is the adjective?
challenges.misconception: Funny is the adjective — it describes the stories! Grandmother is a noun and tells is a verb.

subject: english

storyArc.theme: An English explorer masters new words, one story at a time

beats.name: setup
beats.sceneDescription: The mascot welcomes the student and introduces the topic
beats.mascotDialogue: Welcome! Let us explore English together!

beats.name: inciting
beats.sceneDescription: A playful challenge appears that needs the new skill
beats.mascotDialogue: Here comes a challenge — can you work it out?

beats.name: rising
beats.sceneDescription: The tasks grow trickier as understanding deepens
beats.mascotDialogue: You are getting stronger! Try these!

beats.name: climax
beats.sceneDescription: The hardest test of the new skill
beats.mascotDialogue: This is the big one! Show me what you learned!
